An account's own hosts: enrol a machine into your personal account or an organisation, list and remove them.

:::caution
Experimental: a deployment serves these only with `KANTEL_CONNECT=experimental`.
:::

## Enrol a host into an account

`POST /v1/connect/enrolments` (SDK method `createConnectEnrolment`)

A one-use token, shown once, and the one-line command that installs the host agent on a Linux machine and enrols it into the account (the caller's personal account unless `account` names an organisation). The host dials out to this deployment and keeps the connection open, so it needs no inbound port. Once it has joined, the account's new sandboxes go on its own hosts, and no other account's sandboxes ever do. A key needs `account:admin`. Experimental: `not_supported` unless the deployment has turned Kantel Connect on.

**Body**: [CreateConnectEnrolmentBody](/api/reference/types/#createconnectenrolmentbody)

**Answers**

- `201`: [ConnectEnrolment](/api/reference/types/#connectenrolment) (`application/json`). The token and its command.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `501` not_supported. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## List an account's hosts

`GET /v1/connect/hosts` (SDK method `listConnectHosts`)

The hosts enrolled into the account, revoked ones included. The deployment's shared hosts aren't listed. A key needs `account:read`. Experimental: `not_supported` unless the deployment has turned Kantel Connect on.

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account` | string | no | The account to act in: the caller's personal account (the default for a person) or an organisation they belong to. An API key always acts in its own account, and naming another is `forbidden`. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [HostList](/api/reference/types/#hostlist) (`application/json`). The hosts.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `501` not_supported. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Get one of an account's hosts

`GET /v1/connect/hosts/{hostId}` (SDK method `getConnectHost`)

A key needs `account:read`. Experimental: `not_supported` unless the deployment has turned Kantel Connect on.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hostId` | string | yes | The host's ID. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [Host](/api/reference/types/#host) (`application/json`). The host.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `501` not_supported. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Change one of an account's hosts

`PATCH /v1/connect/hosts/{hostId}` (SDK method `updateConnectHost`)

Renames it, replaces its labels, or drains it. A key needs `account:admin`. Experimental: `not_supported` unless the deployment has turned Kantel Connect on.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hostId` | string | yes | The host's ID. |

**Body**: [UpdateHostBody](/api/reference/types/#updatehostbody)

**Answers**

- `200`: [Host](/api/reference/types/#host) (`application/json`). The host.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict, `501` not_supported. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Remove one of an account's hosts

`DELETE /v1/connect/hosts/{hostId}` (SDK method `removeConnectHost`)

Revokes its credential and closes its connection. Its sandboxes keep their disks but can't be reached until it is enrolled again. Run `sudo kantel-host uninstall` on the machine to take the agent off it. A key needs `account:admin`. Experimental: `not_supported` unless the deployment has turned Kantel Connect on.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hostId` | string | yes | The host's ID. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [Host](/api/reference/types/#host) (`application/json`). The host, revoked.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `501` not_supported. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).
